name: PC Partner Group Limited
summary: PC Partner Group Limited, an investment holding company, designs, develops, manufactures, and sells computer electronics. The company offers video graphics cards for desktop personal computers (PCs); and other PC related products and components, such as motherboards and mini-PCs. It also designs, manufactures, and trades in PC parts and accessories, and electronics; and provides technical support and company secretarial services, as well as subcontracting services for computer accessories and computers; and holds intellectual properties.
